name: Record Operator
summary: Applies idempotent, versioned record transitions using opaque references and declared state policy.
description: Uses typed record references, expected versions, transition requests, and idempotency keys. Does not select a database, transaction engine, event store, path, provider, or credential.

distinguished_from.how: Owns versioned record state transitions; does not govern immutable byte assets.
Applies record state transitions; does not evaluate time-based trigger policy.
